value-edits.description: Office・PDFの既存セルや本文文字列を、原本・本文の版と期待する旧値を照合して一括編集する。Excelは値・既存数式・テーブル列見出し・集計ラベルに対応。数式セルのbefore/afterは=付きの数式、文字列セルの=付き文字列は文字列のまま。Word・PowerPoint・PDFは文字列のみ。構造操作中の文書・読み取り専用のフィールド・native textは対象外。

export-confirmation.description: 描画の自動安全判定ではなく、出力を開いてレイアウトを確認した記録。applyはこの候補の同一バイトだけを適用する。

batch-plan.description: record・adopt・reviewの--dry-run --outが保存し、--expectで読む計画。記載した文書だけを、contentが一致する間だけ処理する。

content.description: All source formats use value arrays (version 4); identities, table topology and source bindings live only in document-layout.

strike.description: Excel cell font is struck through, which authors use to mark a value as deleted.

hidden_rows.description: Excel rows hidden on the sheet. Their cells are still extracted.

hidden_columns.description: Excel columns hidden on the sheet, by letter. Their cells are still extracted.

computed.description: Ranges Excel fills from an array formula or spill, a What-If data table or a pivot table; their member cells are not written back.

checked.description: Saved state of a check box or option button; null for other controls and for the mixed state.

interpretation.description: Canonical correction journal; exact nested contract is document-structure-schema.json#/$defs/correction_journal and is validated by document management.

entries.description: Only entries that differ from those derived from the extraction. Document management derives one entry per cell, formula and page block, and an entry here with the same page, block and field replaces it.

agent_read_format.description: Presentation of agent reading material; storage and reply protocols remain JSON.

document-layout.description: Document positions, identities and value-free element_metadata indexed in the same order as body elements. Only ARP structural operations update both files. Same-shape manual reordering is a value edit, not an identity move.

metadata_sha256.description: Digest of the value-free element_metadata; array slots are bound by this metadata.

element_metadata.description: Readable IDs use a kind prefix and underscore-separated immutable identity components. Component bytes other than ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, dot, slash and hash are UTF-8 percent-encoded (uppercase hex), including underscore and percent. IDs do not hash values or current positions.
